Namebeam Market Citation Records

Namebeam markets catalog: daily record of business names AI engines named for buyer questions per US market. Record generated from a dated daily collection of usable rows. AI-generated data, quality filtered.

Featured (October 2026):
- AI-Named Leaderboard (305 businesses, Perplexity + Google day counts): https://markets.namebeam.ai/leaderboard/
- Two Phone Books (228 of 272 named businesses in the 22 local markets, 83.8%, live in one list. Corrected 2026-10-12: counts recomputed from the saved answer text. The 2026-10-06 version of 223 of 248 (89.9%) is superseded): https://markets.namebeam.ai/two-phone-books/
- The Invisible 100 (businesses Google cites that AI ignores, 92 verified): https://markets.namebeam.ai/invisible-100/
- AI-Named badge (free dated embed for named businesses): https://markets.namebeam.ai/badge/
- Agency white-label audit pack ($397): https://markets.namebeam.ai/agency/
- Press kit and data stories: https://markets.namebeam.ai/press/
- September 2026 corpus recap (24 per-market reports): https://markets.namebeam.ai/reports/september-2026-recap
